title: Lighthouse Profile Transition Preview
description: A deterministic, reviewable artifact describing a PROPOSED profile transition: what would change, what backup evidence supports it, and what a future operator/Gateway must approve. It is evidence, NOT a command: generating it activates nothing, switches nothing, writes no DB state, and contacts no Gateway. A preview reaches transition_status 'ready_for_review' ONLY with two valid profiles, present passing backup evidence, and the producer-owned execution facts (target_policy_snapshot, backup_manifest_sha256, target_profile_sha256 — LHP-PROFILE-14A); otherwise incomplete/blocked/invalid. This document is a human/Gateway-facing reference mirror; the AUTHORITATIVE enforcer is modules/profile_transition.py (ProfileTransitionPreview.validate()).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Unknown/future versions fail closed. LHP-PROFILE-14A evolved this contract ADDITIVELY within version 1 (see deterministic_serialization_version).

preview_id.description: Unique id for this preview. Excluded from artifact_digest (volatile).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 generation timestamp. Excluded from artifact_digest (volatile).

generator_version.description: Producer generator version ('1.1.0' since LHP-PROFILE-14A). Digest-covered.

deterministic_serialization_version.description: Versions the digest content composition. 1 = LHP-PROFILE-03 field set; 2 = LHP-PROFILE-14A (adds the typed target-policy snapshot, the local_only/dms_eligibility change categories, both content digests, and the provenance stamps to the digest-covered content). Future values fail closed.

current_profile_id.description: Currently active profile. NULL until activation ships (foundation transition).

target_profile_id.description: Profile the transition would move TO.

transition_status.description: Fail-closed assessment. 'ready_for_review' requires present, passing evidence, two valid profiles, and the producer execution facts; unknown never becomes ready.

target_policy_snapshot.description: Typed target-policy snapshot (LHP-PROFILE-14A) — the first-class, digest-covered execution facts a consumer previously had to recover from string tokens. Derived ONLY from a validated target profile (null when the target is invalid; required for ready_for_review). schema_migration_required is false by construction: intelligence_profile.v1 defines no migration vocabulary and rejects executable intent.

target_profile_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the target profile's full canonical serialized content (json.dumps of the profile dict with sort_keys and compact separators, UTF-8). Binds the WHOLE profile — including policy blocks the changes diff does not cover — so a consumer can prove the profile is unchanged since review by recomputing from the live registry. Null only when the target is invalid; required for ready_for_review.

lighthouse_version.description: Producer provenance stamp: installed pattern-match-sentinel distribution version. Digest-covered on purpose (tamper-evident provenance); null when distribution metadata is unavailable.

repository_commit.description: Producer provenance stamp: git HEAD of the producing checkout. Digest-covered; null in deployments without a repository (s9pk/Docker).

changes.description: Deterministic, declarative diff between current and target profile policies. Describes differences only; executes nothing. The two scalar categories (LHP-PROFILE-14A) are SIBLINGS of the six dict-diff categories, never keys nested inside them.

local_only_changed.description: Scalar diff {changed, from, to} of privacy_policy.local_only (bool-coerced).

dms_eligibility_changed.description: Scalar diff {changed, from, to} of dead_mans_switch_policy.eligible (bool-coerced).

evidence.description: References to existing LHP-PROFILE-02 backup evidence — status only, never contents/rows/secrets. backup_manifest_sha256 is a content FINGERPRINT of the referenced manifest file (binding, not disclosure).

backup_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the referenced manifest file bytes (LHP-PROFILE-14A). Upgrades evidence binding from id-only to content binding; required for ready_for_review.

backup_verification_status.description: Verbatim status token from the verification report. Pass vocabulary (closed set, module constant VERIFICATION_PASS_STATUSES): exactly 'verified' (typed backup-verify report bound to the manifest file bytes). Create-time backup-create 'passed' never passes.

restore_drill_status.description: Verbatim status token from the restore-drill report. Pass vocabulary (module constant RESTORE_DRILL_PASS_STATUS): exactly 'completed'. Any other value never passes.

evidence_timestamp.description: created_at copied from the referenced manifest. Volatile: EXCLUDED from artifact_digest (same class as preview_id/created_at) — never gate on it.

requirements.description: What a FUTURE Gateway approval must satisfy. Named requirements only — this artifact grants no approval and holds no operator identity.

artifact_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical content, excluding exactly the volatile fields preview_id, created_at, evidence_timestamp, and artifact_digest itself — so identical transition + evidence yields an identical digest regardless of when it was generated. All other fields, including the producer provenance stamps, are digest-covered.
